review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Platform & DevSecOps)
review_candidates.description: About The Role The Senior DevOps Engineer designs, automates, and maintains high-availability, fault-tolerant, and secure infrastructure powering digital financial products (e.g., nano-finance, consumer finance, e-payments, digital insurance brokerage). Operating within an FRA-regulated environment, this role bridges core software development and the CISO's governance framework. The engineer is responsible for embedding DevSecOps pipelines, automated compliance controls, immutable audit logging, and Disaster Recovery (DR) automation into every layer of the cloud and on-premise infrastructure. Key Responsibilities DevSecOps & CI/CD Automation ▪ Design, build, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) ensuring zero-downtime blue/green or canary deployments. ▪ Enforce "shift-left" security controls directly into deployment workflows: integrate automated SAST (Static Application Security Testing), DAST, software composition analysis (SCA), and container image vulnerability scanners (e.g., SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy). ▪ Enforce binary authorization and artifact signing, ensuring only cryptographically verified images are deployed to production clusters. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Architecture ▪ Architect and manage scalable cloud infrastructure (AWS / Microsoft Azure / local data centers) using Terraform or Terragrunt, maintaining 100% declarative infrastructure. ▪ Ensure infrastructure architecture strictly satisfies Egyptian data residency and hosting regulations as outlined under FRA Decree No. 139/2023 and Decree No. 141/2023 (Fintech Outsourcing Register). ▪ Implement network zoning, Micro-segmentation, Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), and Zero-Trust access rules to isolate microservices, payment gateways, and core non-banking ledger systems. Container Orchestration & Platform Engineering ▪ Manage production-grade Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS, or bare metal) focusing on multi-tenancy, resource optimization, autoscaling (HPA/KEDA), and high availability. ▪ Implement Kubernetes security standards: Network Policies, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Pod Security Standards, and runtime threat detection (e.g., Falco). ▪ Provide self-service internal developer platforms (IDPs) that allow product developers to provision test environments and deploy services safely. High Availability, BCM & Disaster Recovery (DR) ▪ Build and automate Disaster Recovery failover protocols to satisfy FRA business continuity thresholds for Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO). ▪ Automate continuous database backups, snapshot replication, and cross-region/cross-zone synchronization. ▪ Lead semi-annual scheduled DR failover drills alongside the CISO and Risk teams, proving operational resilience during simulated complete data center outages. Regulatory Logging, Telemetry & Observability ▪ Deploy enterprise-wide observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog). ▪ Construct tamper-evident, centralized audit log pipelines that stream system, database, and administrative actions directly to the SOC/SIEM, enforcing the FRA's mandatory five-year log retention and immutability rules. ▪ Configure real-time alerts, synthetic monitoring, and SLO/SLI tracking across mission-critical endpoints (digital onboarding, eKYC, and transaction routing). Secrets, Cryptography & eKYC Infrastructure Support ▪ Oversee enterprise secret management using tools like HashiCorp Vault, enforcing short-lived credentials, automated secret rotation, and dynamic database credentials. ▪ Support engineering pipelines that interface with Cloud HSMs and digital signature modules used to seal digital contracts under FRA Decree No. 140 of 2023. Technical Stack ▪ Cloud & Virtualization: AWS, Microsoft Azure, VMware / OpenStack. ▪ Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), Helm, Istio / Linkerd. ▪ Infrastructure as Code & Config: Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible. ▪ CI/CD & GitOps: GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, FluxCD. ▪ Security & Compliance: HashiCorp Vault, Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, Wazuh, Falco. ▪ Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog. ▪ Scripting & Languages: Python, Bash, Go. Requirements Required Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or a related field. Experience 5–8 years of overall IT/Software Engineering experience, with at least 4 years dedicated to DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Platform Engineering in a FinTech, Digital Banking, or highly regulated transactional environment. Regulatory & Security Understanding Proven track record working under strict InfoSec oversight (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or central bank/financial regulator standards); familiarity with Egypt's data privacy (PDPL 151/2020) and FRA IT requirements. Certifications (Preferred) At least one certified tier: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate. Hands-On Depth Strong troubleshooting acumen across Linux kernel internals, TCP/IP networking, DNS, TLS/SSL termination, and distributed systems performance tuning. Core Competencies Security-First Mentality: Considers security and auditability as non-negotiable architectural foundations rather than an afterthought. Automation Advocate: Intolerance for manual, error-prone operational tasks ("toil"); proactive in writing clean automation scripts and IaC modules. Incident Ownership: Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production outages under pressure, conducting blameless post-mortems and driving systemic fixes. Communication: Ability to collaborate seamlessly with software engineers, product managers, quality assurance, and external regulatory auditors.

review_candidates.description: At VyStar, we offer competitive pay, an excellent benefit package that includes a 401(k) Plan, an extensive paid technical and on-the-job training program, and tuition reimbursement--available to all full and part time employees. Part time positions start at a minimum of 30 hours per week. We encourage you to become a part of VyStar Credit Union's family of employees. Senior Cloud Engineer Accountability Statement The Senior Cloud Engineer will plan, design, configure and maintain VyStar’s enterprise Azure cloud server and storage environments and will lead the management and further development of VyStar’s private and public cloud infrastructure. The person in this role will work closely with the architecture team, development team, system engineering team and InfoSec team to design and implement cloud resources in an optimal manner. They will review the cloud environments to validate implemented technologies and improve performance and reliability by ensuring security practices are followed. The incumbent will also manage cost optimization and ensure correct structure and tagging are in place for cost awareness and departmental chargeback. This role will serve as a technical subject matter expert by actively participating in configuration consultation, vendor evaluation, and problem resolution of multiple systems. The candidate should have a clear understanding of how to research, design, implement and troubleshoot information systems, cloud technologies and technology solutions in support of business needs. Under limited supervision, the candidate will be required to effectively manage and prioritize assigned tasks and projects, as well as design complex multi-system solutions to meet the needs of the business. They will be required to make recommendations in these areas with a high level of technical competency. Assigned hours will primarily be standard VyStar corporate business hours but may also include evenings, nights, and weekends to implement changes or for support purposes. This role also participates in an on-call support rotation. Essential Job Functions Responsible for day-to-day Azure cloud infrastructure operational tasks such as monitoring metrics and logs, responding to alerts, and system troubleshooting. Design, develop, and deploy modular cloud-based systems. Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure resources, including compute instances, storage, network configurations, and security. Participate in troubleshooting issues in the environment and takes part in the on-call rotation with other cloud engineers. Develop and maintain cloud solutions in accordance with best practices. Foster a DevOps mindset among the various engineering teams utilizing BICEP, ARM, Terraform and YAML templates. Use of automation such as Infrastructure as Code to create infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to apply changes. Participate in production deployments with other cloud and software engineers. Develop scripts and other automation to streamline cloud and on-premises operations. Maintain documentation of infrastructures design, related technical procedures, operations manuals, and other guidance. Other duties as assigned by the supervisor All employees and business units, as first line of defense, are expected to proactively help identify, assess, manage, and report risks within their domain of work. The Risk team serves as the second line of defense by providing risk oversight and credible challenge whereas the Audit team serves as the third line of defense by providing risk assurance. Connect - Consistently be friendly and approachable. Demonstrate your care. Understand - Listen empathetically and ask questions (70%/30% rule). Counsel - Recommend solutions based on your member’s needs and objectives. Advance - Ensure that member’s expectations were exceeded. Verify necessary follow-up actions. Additional years of related experience in the field may be substituted for the formal education. Demonstrated ability to lead project initiatives from beginning to end. Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are required. Understanding of IT, software development, and DevOps best practices Expert knowledge of multiple Windows Server versions (2016/2019/2022/2025). Knowledge and experience in Microsoft Azure. Google Cloud or AWS (Amazon Cloud Services) a plus. Experience with automation technologies and the ability to streamline processes Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS) a plus. Experience with bash, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent scripting language. Experience with version control tools such as Git a plus. Familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment tools such as Azure DevOps Advanced troubleshooting abilities across multiple technologies and vendors. Able to calmly provide support on bridge lines during outages. Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, and VPN. Knowledge of security best practices, compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA), and data protection mechanisms in the cloud. A solid understanding of the financial services industry and the laws and regulations that govern and/or impact the credit union is a plus. A high level of interpersonal skills and social sensitivity are required. The candidate encounters employees on all levels of the organization. The candidate is a resource to the organization and must be an effective listener and communicator. The candidate must set the example in attitude, behavior, and work ethic within multiple teams.
